queries.title: Reject from POS / Update Active Status
queries.purpose: Use this to find and deactivate a partial invoice or enquiry stuck as active. Needed when a quote or partial entry cannot be cleared from the POS screen.
queries.steps:
1. Enter the Enquiry # or Job # in the input above
2. Run the first SELECT to verify the record exists
3. If confirmed, run the UPDATE to set int_active = -1 (deactivates it)
4. Verify by running the SELECT again

queries.title: General Branch & Item Info
queries.purpose: Quick lookup of a branch record and item record. First step to get internal pk_bint_id values needed for deeper stock queries.
queries.steps:
1. Enter Branch Name/Code and Item Code
2. Run to get pk_bint_id for both
3. Use these IDs in stock detail queries below
queries.sql:
SELECT pk_bint_id, vchr_name, vchr_code FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}' OR vchr_code = '{{br_code}}';
SELECT pk_bint_id, vchr_item_code, vchr_item_name FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}';

SELECT sum(int_received) FROM branch_stock_details bsd 
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id 
WHERE bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}') 
AND bsd.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}';

SELECT sum(int_qty) FROM branch_stock_details bsd 
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id 
WHERE bsd.fk_item_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}') 
AND bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}') 
AND bsd.jsn_batch_no::jsonb -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}';

-- 1. Check by branch and batch
SELECT bsid.*
FROM branch_stock_imei_details bsid
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.pk_bint_id = bsid.fk_details_id
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id
WHERE bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}' OR vchr_code = '{{br_code}}')
AND bsid.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}';

-- 2. Check by item, branch and batch
SELECT bsid.*
FROM branch_stock_imei_details bsid
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.pk_bint_id = bsid.fk_details_id
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id
WHERE bsd.fk_item_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}')
AND bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}')
AND bsid.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}';

-- 3. Check specific IMEI exists
SELECT bsid.*
FROM branch_stock_imei_details bsid
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.pk_bint_id = bsid.fk_details_id
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id
WHERE bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}')
AND bsid.jsn_imei -> 'imei' ? '{{imei}}';

-- 4. Sum qty/received from imei details by branch + batch
SELECT 
    sum(bsid.int_qty)      AS total_qty,
    sum(bsid.int_received) AS total_received
FROM branch_stock_imei_details bsid
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.pk_bint_id = bsid.fk_details_id
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id
WHERE bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}')
AND bsid.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}';

-- 5. Check reached vs received (reconciliation)
SELECT 
    bsid.pk_bint_id,
    bsid.jsn_batch_no,
    bsid.jsn_imei,
    bsid.int_qty,
    bsid.int_received,
    bsid.jsn_imei_reached,
    bsid.jsn_batch_reached
FROM branch_stock_imei_details bsid
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.pk_bint_id = bsid.fk_details_id
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id
WHERE bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_name = '{{branch}}')
AND bsid.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}'
AND bsid.int_qty != bsid.int_received;  -- mismatch check

queries.title: Branch Stock Details (by Item + Branch Code)
queries.purpose: Detailed stock records for a specific item at a specific branch. Shows quantity, IMEI availability and batch info. Essential before making any stock correction.
queries.steps:
1. Enter Item Code and Branch Code (short code like HPF, KGF)
2. Optionally enter Batch/IMEI to narrow results
3. Use SELECT to verify stock before running any UPDATE
queries.sql:
SELECT bsd.* FROM branch_stock_details bsd 
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id 
WHERE bsd.int_qty > 0
AND bsd.fk_item_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}') 
AND bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_code = '{{br_code}}')
AND bsd.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}'
AND jsn_imei_avail -> 'imei_avail' ? '{{batch}}';

SELECT bsd.* FROM branch_stock_details bsd 
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id 
WHERE bsd.fk_item_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}') 
AND bsm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_code = '{{br_code}}')
AND jsn_imei -> 'imei' ? '{{batch}}';

SELECT gd.pk_bint_id,int_qty,int_avail,vchr_batch_no,fk_branch_id 
FROM grn_details gd JOIN grn_master gm ON gm.pk_bint_id = gd.fk_purchase_id 
WHERE gm.fk_branch_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM branch WHERE vchr_code = '{{br_code}}') 
AND gd.fk_item_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}') 
AND vchr_batch_no = '{{batch}}';

queries.title: Find and Update Sales Details (IMEI/Batch Fix)
queries.purpose: When a sale was recorded with the wrong IMEI or batch number, use this query chain to find the exact sales_details row and correct it. Run SELECTs first.
queries.steps:
1. Enter Invoice # and the WRONG Batch/IMEI
2. Enter Item Code to narrow by item
3. Run SELECT queries to identify the row
4. Enter the CORRECT IMEI in the To Batch field
5. Run the UPDATE query
6. Verify with a final SELECT
queries.sql:
SELECT * FROM sales_master WHERE vchr_invoice_num IN ('{{invoice}}');
SELECT 
    sm.vchr_invoice_num,
    b.vchr_code       AS branch_code,
    b.vchr_name       AS branch_name,
    i.vchr_item_code  AS item_code,
    i.vchr_name       AS item_name,
    sd.json_imei
FROM sales_master sm
JOIN branch b 
    ON b.pk_bint_id = sm.fk_branch_id
JOIN sales_details sd 
    ON sd.fk_master_id = sm.pk_bint_id
JOIN item i 
    ON i.pk_bint_id = sd.fk_item_id
WHERE sm.vchr_invoice_num = '{{invoice}}'
AND sd.json_imei ? '{{batch}}';


SELECT sd.pk_bint_id,fk_master_id,fk_item_id,int_qty,json_imei 
FROM sales_details sd 
JOIN sales_master sm ON sd.fk_master_id = sm.pk_bint_id 
WHERE sm.vchr_invoice_num IN ('{{invoice}}') 
AND sd.json_imei ? '{{batch}}' 
AND sd.fk_item_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}');

SELECT pk_bint_id,fk_master_id,fk_item_id,int_qty,json_imei 
FROM sales_details 
WHERE fk_master_id = (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM sales_master WHERE vchr_invoice_num IN ('{{invoice}}')) 
AND json_imei ? '{{batch}}';

UPDATE sales_details SET json_imei = '["{{to_batch}}"]' 
WHERE fk_master_id IN (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM sales_master WHERE vchr_invoice_num IN ('{{invoice}}')) 
AND json_imei ? '{{batch}}';

-- ============================================
--  CHECK BRANCH STOCK DETAILS
-- (BATCH OR IMEI EXISTENCE + QTY)
-- ============================================

SELECT bsd.pk_bint_id,
       bsd.int_qty,
       bsd.jsn_batch_no,
       bsd.jsn_imei
FROM branch_stock_details bsd
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm 
    ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id
JOIN item i 
    ON i.pk_bint_id = bsd.fk_item_id
JOIN branch b 
    ON b.pk_bint_id = bsm.fk_branch_id
WHERE b.vchr_code = '{{br_code}}'
AND i.vchr_item_code = '{{item}}'
AND (
    bsd.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{to_batch}}'
    OR bsd.jsn_imei -> 'imei' ? '{{to_batch}}'
);

-- BRANCH STOCK IMEI DETAILS
SELECT bsid.pk_bint_id,
       bsid.fk_details_id,
       bsid.int_qty,
       bsid.jsn_batch_no,
       bsid.jsn_imei
FROM branch_stock_imei_details bsid
WHERE bsid.fk_details_id = {{bsd_id}}
AND (
    bsid.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{to_batch}}'
    OR bsid.jsn_imei -> 'imei' ? '{{to_batch}}'
);
--UPDATIONS

BEGIN;
-- Branch stock details
UPDATE branch_stock_details
SET int_qty = {{new_qty}}
WHERE pk_bint_id = {{bsd_id}};

-- Branch stock IMEI details
UPDATE branch_stock_imei_details
SET int_qty = {{new_qty}}
WHERE pk_bint_id = {{bsid_id}};

queries.title: DELETE Duplicate / Full Invoice (Full Flow)
queries.purpose: When a duplicate sales invoice was created or a full invoice must be deleted. Always run inside BEGIN/ROLLBACK first. Deletes: sales_details, finance_details, payment_details, transaction, sales_master.
queries.steps:
1. Enter the Invoice # of the duplicate/to-delete
2. Run inside BEGIN to preview all related records
3. Verify pk_bint_id of the correct record to delete
4. Run DELETE statements in order
5. COMMIT only after confirming

queries.title: Transfer Details & IST
queries.purpose: View a stock transfer in full — IST details, IMEI layer, branch_stock_details. Use this to diagnose why a transfer is not reflecting correctly at the destination branch.
queries.steps:
1. Enter Transfer # and Batch/IMEI
2. Run SELECT on ist_details to see line items
3. Check quantity fields for mismatches
4. Use UPDATE queries only after confirming
queries.sql:
SELECT array_agg(pk_bint_id) FROM stock_transfer WHERE vchr_stktransfer_num IN ('{{transfer}}');

SELECT 
    id.*,
    it.vchr_item_code,
    st.vchr_stktransfer_num
FROM ist_details id
JOIN item it 
    ON it.pk_bint_id = id.fk_item_id
JOIN stock_transfer st
    ON st.pk_bint_id = id.fk_transfer_id
WHERE st.vchr_stktransfer_num = '{{transfer}}'
AND id.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}';

SELECT * FROM ist_details WHERE fk_transfer_id IN (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM stock_transfer WHERE vchr_stktransfer_num IN ('{{transfer}}'))
AND jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ? '{{batch}}'
AND fk_item_id IN (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}');




SELECT * FROM ist_details WHERE fk_transfer_id IN (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM stock_transfer WHERE vchr_stktransfer_num IN ('{{transfer}}'))
AND jsn_imei -> 'imei' ? '{{batch}}';

SELECT * FROM stock_transfer_imei_details where fk_details_id =(SELECT pk_bint_id FROM ist_details WHERE fk_transfer_id IN (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM stock_transfer WHERE vchr_stktransfer_num IN ('{{transfer}}'))
AND jsn_imei -> 'imei' ? '{{batch}}');
SELECT *
FROM stock_transfer_imei_details
WHERE fk_details_id IN (
    SELECT pk_bint_id
    FROM ist_details
    WHERE fk_transfer_id IN (
        SELECT pk_bint_id
        FROM stock_transfer
        WHERE vchr_stktransfer_num IN ('{{transfer}}')
    )
    AND jsn_imei -> 'imei' ? '{{batch}}'
);
-- Branch stock master id
SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT(bsm.pk_bint_id)) AS bsm_id FROM branch_stock_details bsd 
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsd.fk_master_id = bsm.pk_bint_id 
WHERE fk_transfer_details_id IN (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM ist_details WHERE fk_transfer_id IN (SELECT pk_bint_id FROM stock_transfer WHERE vchr_stktransfer_num IN ('{{transfer}}')));

BEGIN;

UPDATE ist_details id
SET dbl_supplier_amt = it.dbl_supplier_cost
FROM item it
WHERE it.pk_bint_id = id.fk_item_id
  AND id.fk_transfer_id IN (
      SELECT pk_bint_id
      FROM stock_transfer
      WHERE vchr_stktransfer_num = '{{transfer}}'
  );

COMMIT;

queries.title: Fix IST / BSD Qty Mismatch (BEGIN/COMMIT Flow)
queries.purpose: When int_qty in ist_details does not match int_received in branch_stock_details or branch_stock_imei_details. Detects and fixes mismatches at both BSD and IMEI layers.
queries.steps:
1. Enter Transfer # and Batch/IMEI
2. Run step 1 (detect) to see mismatches
3. Run step 2 UPDATE for BSD fix
4. Run step 3 to verify BSD
5. Run step 4-5 for IMEI layer
6. COMMIT or ROLLBACK
queries.sql:
BEGIN;

-- 1. Detect mismatch between IST and Branch Stock Details
SELECT st.vchr_stktransfer_num, id.pk_bint_id AS ist_details_id,
    (id.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ->> 0) AS batch_no,
    id.int_qty, bsd.int_received
FROM stock_transfer st
JOIN ist_details id ON id.fk_transfer_id = st.pk_bint_id
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.fk_transfer_details_id = id.pk_bint_id
WHERE st.vchr_stktransfer_num = '{{transfer}}'
AND (id.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ->> 0) = '{{batch}}'
AND id.int_qty <> bsd.int_received;

-- 2. Fix mismatch in Branch Stock Details
UPDATE branch_stock_details bsd SET int_received = id.int_qty
FROM stock_transfer st JOIN ist_details id ON id.fk_transfer_id = st.pk_bint_id
WHERE bsd.fk_transfer_details_id = id.pk_bint_id
AND st.vchr_stktransfer_num = '{{transfer}}'
AND (id.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ->> 0) = '{{batch}}'
AND id.int_qty <> bsd.int_received;

-- 3. Detect IMEI layer mismatch
SELECT st.vchr_stktransfer_num, id.pk_bint_id AS ist_details_id,
    bsid.pk_bint_id AS imei_detail_id,
    (id.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ->> 0) AS batch_no, id.int_qty, bsid.int_received
FROM stock_transfer st
JOIN ist_details id ON id.fk_transfer_id = st.pk_bint_id
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.fk_transfer_details_id = id.pk_bint_id
JOIN branch_stock_imei_details bsid ON bsid.fk_details_id = bsd.pk_bint_id
WHERE st.vchr_stktransfer_num = '{{transfer}}'
AND (id.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ->> 0) = '{{batch}}'
AND id.int_qty <> bsid.int_received;

-- 4. Fix IMEI mismatch (SAFE ONLY IF 1 IMEI ROW PER DETAIL)
UPDATE branch_stock_imei_details bsid SET int_received = id.int_qty
FROM stock_transfer st JOIN ist_details id ON id.fk_transfer_id = st.pk_bint_id
JOIN branch_stock_details bsd ON bsd.fk_transfer_details_id = id.pk_bint_id
WHERE bsid.fk_details_id = bsd.pk_bint_id
AND st.vchr_stktransfer_num = '{{transfer}}'
AND (id.jsn_batch_no -> 'batch' ->> 0) = '{{batch}}'
AND id.int_qty <> bsid.int_received;

-- If everything looks correct: COMMIT;
-- If anything looks wrong:    ROLLBACK;

queries.title: GRN Updates (Totals, Cost Price, Supplier)
queries.purpose: Fix GRN issues — update total amount, item cost price, or supplier on a GRN. Also checks for Goods Return issues.
queries.steps:
1. Enter GRN # and Item Code
2. Run SELECT to verify the GRN exists
3. Run the specific UPDATE needed
4. Verify the change

queries.title: GRN 500 Error Fix (Infinity/NaN values)
queries.purpose: When the GRN list throws a 500 server error, this query checks for Infinity, -Infinity, or NaN float values in grn_details which cause the error.
queries.steps:
1. Run the SELECT to find the bad rows
2. Note the pk_bint_id of affected rows
3. Update those rows with a correct value
queries.sql:
SELECT * FROM grn_details
WHERE dbl_dscnt_percent IN ('Infinity'::float, '-Infinity'::float, 'NaN'::float)
   OR dbl_dscnt_perunit IN ('Infinity'::float, '-Infinity'::float, 'NaN'::float)
   OR dbl_discount      IN ('Infinity'::float, '-Infinity'::float, 'NaN'::float)
   OR dbl_costprice     IN ('Infinity'::float, '-Infinity'::float, 'NaN'::float);

queries.title: Job Master & Service Items Lookup
queries.purpose: Full lookup of a job card — job header, associated service items, and linked enquiry. Use when a job card is stuck or service items are not showing correctly.
queries.steps:
1. Enter Job # 
2. Run SELECT on job_master to check job status
3. Run SELECT on item_service to see all service items linked
4. Check status and closed_date fields for anomalies
queries.sql:
SELECT * FROM job_master WHERE vchr_job_num IN ('{{job}}');

SELECT * FROM item_service WHERE fk_job_master_id = (
  SELECT pk_bint_id FROM job_master WHERE vchr_job_num IN ('{{job}}')
);

SELECT * FROM enquiry_master WHERE vchr_enquiry_num IN ('{{enquiry}}');

SELECT jm.*, em.vchr_enquiry_num 
FROM job_master jm 
LEFT JOIN enquiry_master em ON jm.fk_enquiry_id = em.pk_bint_id
WHERE jm.vchr_job_num IN ('{{job}}');


--TO REMOVE SPARE 
-- 1. Verify service spare JSON
SELECT pk_bint_id, jsn_purchase_spare
FROM item_service
WHERE fk_job_master_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id
    FROM job_master
    WHERE vchr_job_num = '{{job}}'
);

-- 2. Verify spare detail row
SELECT *
FROM job_spare_details
WHERE fk_details_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id
    FROM item_service
    WHERE fk_job_master_id = (
        SELECT pk_bint_id
        FROM job_master
        WHERE vchr_job_num = '{{job}}'
    )
)
AND vchr_imei = '{{imei}}';

-- =================================
-- UPDATE / DELETE BLOCK
-- =================================

BEGIN;

-- Remove from JSON spare list
UPDATE item_service
SET jsn_purchase_spare = (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(elem)
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(jsn_purchase_spare::jsonb) elem
    WHERE NOT (
        elem->>'itemCode' = '{{item_code}}'
        AND elem->'lstAllImei' @> to_jsonb(ARRAY['{{imei}}'])
    )
)
WHERE fk_job_master_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id
    FROM job_master
    WHERE vchr_job_num = '{{job}}'
);

-- Remove from spare details table
DELETE FROM job_spare_details
WHERE fk_details_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id
    FROM item_service
    WHERE fk_job_master_id = (
        SELECT pk_bint_id
        FROM job_master
        WHERE vchr_job_num = '{{job}}'
    )
)
AND vchr_imei = '{{imei}}';

COMMIT;

-- 3. Final verification
SELECT pk_bint_id, jsn_purchase_spare
FROM item_service
WHERE fk_job_master_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id
    FROM job_master
    WHERE vchr_job_num = '{{job}}'
);

SELECT *
FROM job_spare_details
WHERE fk_details_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id
    FROM item_service
    WHERE fk_job_master_id = (
        SELECT pk_bint_id
        FROM job_master
        WHERE vchr_job_num = '{{job}}'
    )
);

queries.title: Item Master Lookup
queries.purpose: Find an item record by code. Useful to get the internal pk_bint_id, or to verify item details like name, category and status.
queries.steps:
1. Enter Item Code
2. Run the SELECT to get item details

queries.title: Job Transfer - acknowlege — POS API Failure (Spare Item / IMEI Mismatch)
queries.purpose: Use when a job transfer acknowledgement fails with "Something happen with POS" error. This happens when a spare item in job_spare_details has the wrong item code (fk_item_id) — the IMEI exists in the from-branch POS stock but under a different item code. Fix is to correct the item on the BI spare record and reset the transfer status.
queries.steps:
1. Get the Job Transfer # from the technician (e.g. 25-JT-MCL3-19263) and enter it in the {{job_transfer}} input
2. Switch to BI DB — Run STEP 1 to get the job transfer record. Note the pk_bint_id, fk_job_master_id, from_branch code, and int_status. If int_status is already 2 and the job is fine, stop here.
3. Still on BI DB — Enter the fk_job_master_id value from Step 1 result into {{pk_id}} input. Run STEP 2 to get all spare items linked to this job. Note every vchr_imei and vchr_item_code in the result.
4. Switch to POS DB — Enter the from_branch code (e.g. MCL3) into {{br_code}}. Run STEP 3 first query with all item codes from Step 2 result. Check which IMEI is missing or appearing under a different item code than expected.
5. Still on POS DB — For any IMEI that did not appear in Step 3 first query, enter that IMEI into {{batch}} and run STEP 3 second query (search by IMEI across all items). This will reveal the actual item code that IMEI is stocked under in POS.
6. Still on BI DB — Enter the correct item code (found in Step 5) into {{item}} and run STEP 4 to get the correct BI item id. Note the id value returned.
7. Switch to POS DB — Enter the correct item code into {{item}} and the IMEI into {{batch}} and run STEP 5 to confirm the IMEI exists in from-branch stock under the correct item. Must return exactly 1 row. If 0 rows — stop, do not proceed, escalate for further investigation.
8. Now identify which case applies:
   — CASE A (wrong item): IMEI in BI matches POS but item code is different → will fix fk_item_id
   — CASE B (wrong IMEI): item code matches but IMEI in BI is different from POS → enter correct IMEI into {{to_batch}}, will fix vchr_imei
9. Switch to BI DB — Enter the job_spare_details pk_bint_id of the wrong spare row into {{pk_id}}. Run STEP 6 BEGIN block. Check the before SELECT result carefully.
10. Run only the relevant UPDATE — CASE A or CASE B, not both. Check the after SELECT — fk_item_id should now show correct item id (Case A) or vchr_imei should show correct IMEI (Case B).
11. If both SELECTs look correct — run COMMIT. If anything looks wrong — run ROLLBACK and re-investigate.
12. Still on BI DB — Run STEP 7 to reset the job transfer int_status back to 1. Verify before and after SELECTs, then COMMIT. This allows the technician to re-acknowledge the transfer from the app.
13. Inform the technician to retry the acknowledgement from the app. The POS API should now find the correct IMEI under the correct item in from-branch stock and complete successfully.
queries.sql:
-- =============================================
-- STEP 1 (BI DB): Get job transfer record
-- Input: {{job_transfer}} e.g. 25-JT-MCL3-19263
-- Note: pk_bint_id, fk_job_master_id, from_branch, int_status
-- =============================================
SELECT jt.pk_bint_id, jt.int_status,
       jt.fk_job_master_id,
       fb.vchr_code AS from_branch,
       tb.vchr_code AS to_branch
FROM job_transfer jt
JOIN branch fb ON fb.pk_bint_id = jt.fk_from_id
JOIN branch tb ON tb.pk_bint_id = jt.fk_to_id
WHERE jt.vchr_doc_num = '{{job_transfer}}';

-- =============================================
-- STEP 2 (BI DB): Get all spares for this job
-- Input: {{pk_id}} = fk_job_master_id from Step 1
-- Note: pk_bint_id, vchr_imei, vchr_item_code for each spare
-- =============================================
SELECT jsd.pk_bint_id, jsd.vchr_imei, jsd.fk_item_id,
       i.vchr_item_code, i.vchr_item_name,
       jsd.dbl_amount, jsd.dbl_purchase_price
FROM job_spare_details jsd
JOIN items i ON i.id = jsd.fk_item_id
JOIN item_service isc ON isc.pk_bint_id = jsd.fk_details_id
WHERE isc.fk_job_master_id = {{pk_id}};

-- =============================================
-- STEP 3 (POS DB): Check from-branch stock for all spare item codes
-- Input: {{br_code}} = from_branch from Step 1
--        {{item}}    = item codes from Step 2 (add all codes in the IN list)
-- Look for any IMEI that is missing or under a different item code
-- =============================================
SELECT bsd.pk_bint_id, bsd.int_qty,
       bsd.jsn_imei_avail,
       i.vchr_item_code, b.vchr_code AS branch
FROM branch_stock_details bsd
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsm.pk_bint_id = bsd.fk_master_id
JOIN branch b ON b.pk_bint_id = bsm.fk_branch_id
JOIN item i ON i.pk_bint_id = bsd.fk_item_id
WHERE b.vchr_code = '{{br_code}}'
AND i.vchr_item_code IN ('{{item}}')
AND bsd.int_qty > 0;

-- If an IMEI is missing from above, search by IMEI across all items in that branch:
-- Input: {{batch}} = the missing IMEI from Step 2
SELECT bsd.pk_bint_id, bsd.int_qty, bsd.jsn_imei_avail,
       i.vchr_item_code, b.vchr_code AS branch
FROM branch_stock_details bsd
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsm.pk_bint_id = bsd.fk_master_id
JOIN branch b ON b.pk_bint_id = bsm.fk_branch_id
JOIN item i ON i.pk_bint_id = bsd.fk_item_id
WHERE b.vchr_code = '{{br_code}}'
AND bsd.jsn_imei_avail -> 'imei' ? '{{batch}}'
AND bsd.int_qty > 0;

-- =============================================
-- STEP 4 (BI DB): Get correct BI item id for the right item code
-- Input: {{item}} = correct item code found in POS Step 3 second query
-- Note the id — needed for Case A fix in Step 6
-- =============================================
SELECT id, vchr_item_code, vchr_item_name
FROM items
WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}';

-- =============================================
-- STEP 5 (POS DB): Verify IMEI exists in from-branch under correct item
-- Input: {{br_code}} = from_branch
--        {{item}}    = correct item code from Step 3
--        {{batch}}   = IMEI in question
-- MUST return exactly 1 row — if 0 rows stop and escalate
-- =============================================
SELECT bsd.pk_bint_id, bsd.int_qty, bsd.jsn_imei_avail,
       i.vchr_item_code, b.vchr_code AS branch
FROM branch_stock_details bsd
JOIN branch_stock_master bsm ON bsm.pk_bint_id = bsd.fk_master_id
JOIN branch b ON b.pk_bint_id = bsm.fk_branch_id
JOIN item i ON i.pk_bint_id = bsd.fk_item_id
WHERE b.vchr_code = '{{br_code}}'
AND i.vchr_item_code = '{{item}}'
AND bsd.jsn_imei_avail -> 'imei' ? '{{batch}}'
AND bsd.int_qty > 0;
-- Must return exactly 1 row before proceeding to Step 6

-- =============================================
-- STEP 6 (BI DB): Fix wrong item code OR wrong IMEI on spare record
-- Input: {{pk_id}}    = job_spare_details pk_bint_id of the wrong spare row
--        {{item}}     = correct item code (Case A)
--        {{batch}}    = IMEI on the spare record (Case A safety check)
--        {{to_batch}} = correct IMEI from POS (Case B)
-- Run only AFTER Step 5 returns exactly 1 row
-- Run only ONE case — Case A or Case B, never both
-- =============================================
BEGIN;

-- Verify spare record before touching
SELECT pk_bint_id, vchr_imei, fk_item_id
FROM job_spare_details
WHERE pk_bint_id = {{pk_id}};

-- ── CASE A: Wrong item code (IMEI is correct, item code is wrong in BI) ──
-- Use when IMEI matches POS but fk_item_id points to wrong item
UPDATE job_spare_details
SET fk_item_id = (SELECT id FROM items WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}')
WHERE pk_bint_id = {{pk_id}}
AND vchr_imei = '{{batch}}';  -- safety: IMEI must match

-- ── CASE B: Wrong IMEI (item code is correct, IMEI was entered wrong in BI) ──
-- Use when item code matches but IMEI in BI does not match what POS has
-- Input: {{to_batch}} = correct IMEI from POS Step 5
UPDATE job_spare_details
SET vchr_imei = '{{to_batch}}'
WHERE pk_bint_id = {{pk_id}}
AND fk_item_id = (SELECT id FROM items WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item}}');  -- safety: item must match

-- Verify after update
SELECT pk_bint_id, vchr_imei, fk_item_id
FROM job_spare_details
WHERE pk_bint_id = {{pk_id}};

-- ROLLBACK;  -- run if anything looks wrong
-- COMMIT;    -- run only after both SELECTs look correct

-- =============================================
-- STEP 7 (BI DB): Reset job transfer status to retry acknowledgement
-- Input: {{job_transfer}} = job transfer doc number
-- int_status 1 = pending acknowledgement
-- int_status 2 = acknowledged (stuck state after POS failure)
-- Reset to 1 so technician can re-acknowledge from the app
-- =============================================
BEGIN;

-- Verify current status
SELECT pk_bint_id, vchr_doc_num, int_status
FROM job_transfer
WHERE vchr_doc_num = '{{job_transfer}}';

-- Reset status
UPDATE job_transfer
SET int_status = 1
WHERE vchr_doc_num = '{{job_transfer}}'
AND int_status = 2;  -- safety: only reset if currently stuck

-- Verify after reset
SELECT pk_bint_id, vchr_doc_num, int_status
FROM job_transfer
WHERE vchr_doc_num = '{{job_transfer}}';

-- ROLLBACK;  -- if anything looks wrong
-- COMMIT;    -- only after verifying int_status changed to 1

queries.title: SOME ERROR IN POS When Batch Button Selected
queries.purpose: When a batch item is selected in the MyGoal app, the Item Aging  Check API crashes with "Some error in POS" error. Root cause  is int_qty saved as NULL in the non_saleable table when a batch item  is marked as non-saleable without a quantity. Fix by setting  int_qty = 1 for all affected records.
queries.steps:
1. Enter the item code reported by the user in {{item_code}}.
2. Run the SELECT to confirm NULL int_qty records exist for that item.
3. Run the UPDATE to fix the NULL quantities.
4. Re-run the SELECT to confirm 0 rows remain.
5. Ask the user to retry selecting the batch in the MyGoal app.
queries.sql:
SELECT 
    ns.pk_bint_id,
    ns.jsn_non_saleable,
    ns.int_qty,
    ns.int_status,
    ns.int_batch_or_imei,
    i.vchr_item_code
FROM non_saleable ns
JOIN item i ON i.pk_bint_id = ns.fk_item_id
WHERE ns.int_status = 0 
  AND ns.int_batch_or_imei = 1
  AND ns.int_qty IS NULL
  AND i.vchr_item_code = '{{item_code}}';


UPDATE non_saleable 
SET int_qty = 1 
WHERE int_status = 0 
  AND int_batch_or_imei = 1 
  AND int_qty IS NULL
  AND fk_item_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id FROM item WHERE vchr_item_code = '{{item_code}}'
  );

queries.title: Fix Receipt Linked to Wrong Customer (Duplicate Mobile)
queries.purpose: When a receipt is billed under a duplicate/wrong customer (same mobile number),  this query reassigns both the receipt and its transaction to the correct customer.
queries.steps:
1. Fill in the first two variables:
   - mobile_number  → customer mobile (e.g. 9947771188)
   - receipt_number → the RV number (e.g. 25-RV-PMF-19236)

2. Run Step 1 — lists all customers with that mobile number
   → CORRECT customer:  usually int_cust_type = 4, full proper name
   → WRONG customer:    usually int_cust_type = 0, generic/partial name
   → Note down both pk_bint_id values

3. Run Step 2 — confirms receipt exists and shows current wrong customer

4. Run Step 3 — confirms transaction is also under wrong customer

5. Now fill the remaining two variables:
   - correct_customer_id → pk_bint_id of intended customer (e.g. 200100)
   - wrong_customer_id   → pk_bint_id of duplicate customer (e.g. 170477)

6. Run Steps 4 & 5 (BEGIN block) — applies fix to both receipt and transaction

7. Run Step 6 — verify both receipt and transaction now show 
   the correct customer name and ID

8. If Step 6 output looks correct:
   → Uncomment COMMIT and run

9. If anything looks wrong:
   → Run ROLLBACK immediately to undo all changes

10. Ask the user to recheck the ledger — the RV should now appear
queries.sql:
-- Step 1: Find all customers with the same mobile number
SELECT 
    pk_bint_id,
    vchr_name,
    int_mobile,
    int_cust_type,
    dat_exp
FROM customer_details 
WHERE int_mobile = {{mobile_number}};

-- Step 2: Find the receipt and its current customer
SELECT 
    r.pk_bint_id,
    r.vchr_receipt_num,
    r.fk_customer_id,
    cd.vchr_name AS current_customer,
    cd.int_cust_type,
    cd.int_mobile
FROM receipt r
JOIN customer_details cd ON cd.pk_bint_id = r.fk_customer_id
WHERE r.vchr_receipt_num = '{{receipt_number}}';

-- Step 3: Check the linked transaction
SELECT 
    t.pk_bint_id,
    t.int_accounts_id,
    cd.vchr_name AS transaction_customer,
    t.int_account_type,
    t.dat_created::date,
    t.fk_branch_id
FROM transaction t
JOIN customer_details cd ON cd.pk_bint_id = t.int_accounts_id
WHERE t.int_document_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id FROM receipt 
    WHERE vchr_receipt_num = '{{receipt_number}}'
)
AND t.int_document_type = 1;

-- ⚠️ STOP — Verify Steps 1,2,3 before proceeding
-- Fill correct_customer_id and wrong_customer_id from above results
-- Then run the block below

BEGIN;

-- Step 4: Update receipt to correct customer
UPDATE receipt 
SET fk_customer_id = {{correct_customer_id}}
WHERE vchr_receipt_num = '{{receipt_number}}'
AND fk_customer_id = {{wrong_customer_id}};

-- Step 5: Update transaction to correct customer
UPDATE transaction 
SET int_accounts_id = {{correct_customer_id}}
WHERE int_document_id = (
    SELECT pk_bint_id FROM receipt 
    WHERE vchr_receipt_num = '{{receipt_number}}'
)
AND int_document_type = 1
AND int_accounts_id = {{wrong_customer_id}};

-- Step 6: Verify AFTER update (confirm before committing)
SELECT 
    r.pk_bint_id,
    r.vchr_receipt_num,
    r.fk_customer_id,
    cd.vchr_name AS updated_receipt_customer,
    cd.int_cust_type,
    t.pk_bint_id AS transaction_id,
    t.int_accounts_id AS updated_transaction_customer,
    t.int_account_type,
    t.dat_created::date
FROM receipt r
JOIN customer_details cd ON cd.pk_bint_id = r.fk_customer_id
JOIN transaction t ON t.int_document_id = r.pk_bint_id 
    AND t.int_document_type = 1
    AND t.int_accounts_id = {{correct_customer_id}}
WHERE r.vchr_receipt_num = '{{receipt_number}}';

-- Step 7: If Step 6 looks correct → COMMIT, else → ROLLBACK
COMMIT;
